name: Interchange
author: E. T. Carter
description: From the shoulder of a wet road, a stacked motorway interchange rises into wine-dark sodium fog: a high girder deck on hammerhead and twin-column piers lit by soffit lamps, a curving ramp on flared octagonal columns overhead, and a far viaduct glowing through the haze. Cars pull away with rose tail lights while the puddled asphalt stretches every gold lamp into long broken streaks and fog banks drift.

params.label: Fog
params.effect: How thick the sodium fog is: low shows the far viaduct sharply, high swallows it and swells every halo.

params.label: Lamps
params.effect: Brightness of the lamps, their halos and the pools they throw on the road and piers.

params.label: Wet road
params.effect: How wet the road is: dry asphalt at the bottom, long mirrored streaks and reflected piers at the top.

params.label: Traffic
params.effect: How many cars pull away up the road and run along the far viaduct, from an empty night to full traffic.
